prechild_refuse_if: union3 compiler-bound source78 does not retain byte-exact FP6bd fragment and remove old extern once
unaccepted source changes beyond separate reviewed lane merges
retained actual CPU object stat/pin changed
output exists/grant absent/resource floors or aggregate failed
relocation_rules: Use unchanged874b helper: exact symtab names, actual RELA sh_info SHF_ALLOC. Observe positive counts; no invented numeric counts. The genuine sys_rt_sigreturn/native_signal selection is bound by full78/cfg/source; optimizer may inline its FP call, so no false requirement for separate public-FP self-relocation. Allocated external reset/MXCSR references plus actual C public caller establish both directions. No debug/unallocated-token/substring evidence.
retained_CPU_prechild_rule: Exact stable device/inode/mode/uid/gid/nlink/size/mtime/ctime and receipt pin; no large-object rehash required. Current accepted CPU source5574 unchanged or independently qualified successor before use.
